overview: The Citizen Housing Tier is the primary residential district of Ka Vethan, organized by lineage, civic function, and resonance alignment.
history: Established during Ka Vethan’s early expansion to house Akhevan clades.
Resonance‑aligned dwellings were added to stabilize void‑arcane influence.
Communal plazas became centers of civic life and lineage gatherings.
Civic amenities expanded as population density increased.
Modern Housing Tier remains the core of Akhevan daily life.
hooks: A resonance stabilizer malfunctions in a housing block.
A lineage steward requests help resolving a civic dispute.
A communal plaza experiences unexpected void echoes.
A housing chamber reports anomalous arcane fluctuations.
